Confirming deterioration windows: 20, 60, 250. Math components: coherence 3, persistence 77, residual pressure 88, volatility pressure 79, reversal pressure 40, innovation pressure 47. Latest raw observation age 34.1h. Structural diagnostic only; not a forecast or operating instruction.
